title: Evergreen Park Elementary School District 124
description: d124.org Evergreen Park Elementary School District 124 is a public school district in Evergreen Park, Illinois, a Chicago suburb, serving approximately 1,600 students from preschool through grade 8 across 7 schools. With 150 teachers and an 11 to 1 student-teacher ratio, it holds an 8 out of 10 GreatSchools rating with reading and math proficiency well above Illinois state averages. Led by Superintendent Dr. Robert Machak, the district operates 5 elementary schools, one middle school and an early childhood center. Its budget is approximately 25 to 30 million dollars per year with a Recognition-level financial rating from the Illinois State Board of Education. Programs include STEM, gifted education, special education, arts, athletics and 1:1 Chromebook technology integration. The district's motto is Learning Today, Leading Tomorrow, reflecting strong academic growth and community engagement.
